notes:
501(c)(3) founded 2003; an information and advocacy backbone, NOT a shelter - it does not house or adopt out animals. Best used as a curated directory when you need a partner org, low-cost s/n, licensing help, or emergency-vet lists. Mailing 244 5th Ave, NY. Runs the Adoptapalooza mega-adoption events. Phone: (no public adoption phone line - info org) Email: (via contact form on site) Intake: adoption, spay/neuter, microchip, dog licensing, emergency vets, lost & found

501(c)(3) founded 2003; NYC's central animal-welfare information hub and network of ~35+ Participating Organizations (shelters/rescues). Not itself a shelter, but the best single starting point to find a NYC-area rescue for a given species - many members take rabbits, exotics and birds in addition to cats/dogs. Also a good way to discover hyper-local/newer rescues not individually listed here. Cross-listed with the cat & dog references. Phone: (via animalalliancenyc.org) Email: (via animalalliancenyc.org contact) Intake: Not an intake org - use its directory of Participating Organizations + resources at Intake: some member orgs take rabbits/exotics/birds. Hosts periodic Adoptapalooza / Paws in the Park mega-adoption events (feature rabbits and some small animals). Other channel: IG/FB @mayorsalliancenyc
